Gets the SCIM attribute details for the specified ID.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/idp/:idpId/scimattribute/:scimAttributeId

Gets the SCIM attribute details for the specified ID.

​

int64
REQUIRED
